name: Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2027
short_description: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon returns to Kelantan on Saturday 11 September 2027, over 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: The Kota Bharu Half Marathon is scheduled for Saturday 11 September 2027 in Kota Bharu, Kelantan. It is one of the few AIMS-sanctioned road races on Malaysia's east coast, and unusually for the region it is run on a Saturday rather than a Sunday. Distances shown are those of the most recent edition; the 2027 line-up has not been published yet. The 2026 edition started from Dewan Jubli Perak in the centre of Kota Bharu.

faqs.question: When is the Kota Bharu Half Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Saturday 11 September 2027, in Kota Bharu, Kelantan. A Saturday date is unusual for a Malaysian road race, most of which are run on Sunday mornings, so check the day carefully when booking travel to the east coast.

faqs.question: What distances does the Kota Bharu Half Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: A 21.1 km half marathon as the headline distance, with 10 km and 5 km races alongside it. These are the distances from the most recent edition; the organisers have not yet published the 2027 categories, entry fees or start times.
